purpose: Describe a result as a natural consequence of the conditions.
keywords: talk about time sequence duration habits
give explain a reason cause result
V dictionary + べくして + same V, usually past
Unprepared, we lost as was only to be expected.
Ignoring safety made this an accident waiting to happen.
After so much practice, he deservedly won.
formation: V dictionary + べくして + same V, usually past
restrictions: Often judges a failure or success retrospectively.
mistake: The repeated verb links inevitability to the actual result.
